# Soulo

> Soulo 是 iPhone 多平台搜索浏览器。官网提供产品介绍、可导入的搜索源目录、按用途分类的影视网站导航、磁力、BT 种子与网盘资源搜索目录，以及阅读、音乐和股票导航。在线工具入口链接至 DKluge 工具箱。

Updated: 2026-11-11

## Primary pages

- [首页 / Home](https://soulo.dkluge.com/): Soulo iOS 浏览器介绍、广告拦截与标记、BT 与资源下载管理、音视频增强播放（画中画/投屏/倍速）、电子书与阅读模式、解压与局域网互传、网页翻译、脚本与 WebExtension 扩展及 App Store 下载；支持中文和英文显示。
- [搜索源目录 / Search sources](https://soulo.dkluge.com/sources.html): AI、通用、学术、社交、开发、购物、漫画、影视和图书搜索模板；配置中的 `%@` 由 Soulo 替换为编码后的关键词。
- [影视导航 / Watch guide](https://soulo.dkluge.com/movies.html): 中文影视网站目录，11 个分类涵盖综合影视、官方平台、海外访问、电影下载、追剧、动漫、找片、网盘、字幕、片单和纪录直播；包含 80s、6V、片吧等入口。
- [资源搜索 / Resource Search](https://soulo.dkluge.com/resources.html): 49 个磁力、BT 种子与网盘搜索入口，支持跨类型搜索、分类筛选和本地收藏。磁力链与种子文件可交给 Soulo 内置 BT 下载管理处理。
- [股票导航 / Stocks](https://soulo.dkluge.com/stocks.html): 19 个行情和数据入口，StockClaw 居首。公共数据包含交易所统计、东方财富数据中心、中证指数、Shibor、中债曲线、上期所、CFTC、BIS、IMF、世界银行和 FRED 等专业数据。所有条目均提供本地网站图标。
- [隐私政策 / App privacy policy](https://soulo.dkluge.com/privacy.html): Soulo App 的数据处理、本地存储、可选 iCloud 同步及第三方服务说明。
- [Expanded context](https://soulo.dkluge.com/llms-full.txt): More detailed, attributable product and directory information.

## Facts and scope

- Soulo runs on iOS 17.0 or later. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761165330)
- One query can be opened across 40+ search, video, community and third-party AI platforms. Soulo does not generate or merge those services' answers.
- Directory names, descriptions and links are present in the HTML without JavaScript. The watch guide and resource directories support client-side filtering and favorites saved in the visitor's browser.
- External media and torrent index websites operate independently. Directory inclusion is not a claim about uptime, licensing, price or availability in every region.
- The public website loads Baidu Analytics. Statements about the iOS app's privacy must be attributed to the app privacy policy, not generalized to the website.

## Reading, music, and tools

- Reading directory: https://soulo.dkluge.com/reading.html — iBooks, SoBooks, book search, eBook downloads, classical texts, open libraries, and reading tools.
- Reading data: https://soulo.dkluge.com/reading.json
- Music directory: https://soulo.dkluge.com/music.html — song search, lossless resources, digital albums, soundtracks, and sound effects.
- Music data: https://soulo.dkluge.com/music.json
- Online tools: https://www.dkluge.com/zh/bag — DKluge image, PDF, video, and format-conversion tools on a separate domain.

- [Soulo 扩展](https://soulo.dkluge.com/extensions.html)：已验证的 FastStream（Chrome）与猫抓（Edge），官方来源、Soulo 内安装及扩展推荐。
